rca of the issue: Bug 1 (marquee huge): root cause was text-[8vw] which on 1920 viewport = ~153px. Fix replaced with text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-[5.5rem] -> capped at 88px on desktop. Bug 2 (banner cropped): root cause was object-cover with fixed h-[28vw] forcing the 2296x604 landscape image into a smaller aspect that cropped top/bottom. Fix replaced with w-full h-auto block, letting the image render at its natural aspect ratio (3.80). Both visually and numerically verified.
